scope: Conversational basketball research acceptance. This record summarizes reviewed results; it does not contain raw prompts, chat histories, or database records.

ci.verification: Detailed job log reported 703 tests and OK; all job steps succeeded.

method.model_setup: Existing locally imported Q4_K_M weights; the local template may differ from the provider deployment.
method.execution: Real local model requests through application answer_question and telegram_answer paths. Database fixtures were copied into temporary directories.

cases.case: Named-player matchup research with a request for brevity
cases.review: Retrieved source evidence; retained tentative pairing and guarding uncertainty; kept the all-opponent scoring baseline separate from the named-opponent sample; did not infer shooting efficiency from scoring volume.

cases.case: Why followup about a previously discussed made-threes line
cases.review: Retained player, market and line; explained the computed assessment and relevant workload risks; distinguished made shots from attempts and avoided unsupported workload claims.

accepted_behavior_coverage_across_iterat.interpretation: These accepted examples were collected across development iterations, not one final-version end-to-end run. Captured generated drafts were revalidated against the final renderer as described below. The two smoke cases above were actual requests using the final source files.

cases.case: Ask for the missing statistic rather than guess a line market
Apply a PRA correction while retaining player and line
Keep a computed Pass when pressed to choose up or down
Explain the prior assessment in a why followup
Discuss hypothetical blowout minutes without forecasting a blowout
Resolve a player surname typo in a made-threes question
Discuss old-team motivation without treating it as measured shot-attempt evidence
Clarify field-goal versus three-point attempts and request the new line
Recognize a both-team lineup instruction despite a typo
Retain the clarified requirement for at least one player from each team
Respond naturally to a request to ask followup questions

final_captured_output_replay.method: Replayed captured real-model JSON and its source cards through the final factual renderer. This is deterministic revalidation, not 17 new model generations.
final_captured_output_replay.coverage: Accepted correct prior explanations and structural lineup discussion; rejected contradictory recommendations, made-shot-to-attempt or usage substitutions, and scoring-volume-to-efficiency claims.

errors_discovered_and_fixed.fix: A brevity instruction no longer diverts a named-player research question into an empty-evidence preference response; named-player factual requests retain a retrieval path.
A supplied computed decision is anchored in structured output; checks reject the tested contradictory recommendations, including Markdown and phrasing variants.
Supplied computed prop evidence is retained for validation when the model omits an evidence ID; valid lineup cardinal wording no longer triggers a false numeric rejection.
Checks reject the tested made-shot-to-attempt or usage substitutions and scoring-volume-to-efficiency claims.
All-opponent baselines and explicit comparisons that distinguish them from a named opponent retain their scope; relabeling a baseline as opponent-specific remains rejected.
Replies use a concise response budget, hide internal evidence labels, and provide short source context instead of repeating raw evidence dumps.

limits: No external Telegram delivery or Akash provider connectivity was tested by this local acceptance run.
Local hardware, imported model template and source fixtures may differ from the deployed provider.
Both final smoke cases required one repair and took about 56 and 67 seconds. These are observed timings, not speed guarantees.
Some accepted replies remain cautious or wordier than ideal. The suite does not prove perfect accuracy or eliminate future failures.
Historical samples and generated explanations are not calibrated betting probabilities or guaranteed outcomes.
